sloka: यदा ह्यकामां कामार्तो धर्षयिष्यति योषितम् ।मूर्धा तु सप्तधा तस्य शकलीभविता तदा ।। ७.२६.५७ ॥
transliteration: yadā hyakāmāṁ kāmārto dharṣayiṣyati yoṣitam ।mūrdhā tu saptadhā tasya śakalībhavitā tadā ।। 7.26.57 ॥

translations.english: When a lust-struck man violates an unwilling woman, his head will indeed shatter into seven pieces.
